description: This Java class defines a PermissionCriteria model used to specify search or filter parameters for permissions, including fields such as permission name, availability status, group IDs, and availabilities.

classes.name: PermissionCriteria
classes.description: A model class for defining criteria to query or filter permission entities based on various attributes.

methods.name: getAvailabilities
methods.description: Returns the list of availability statuses.

methods.name: setAvailabilities
methods.description: Sets the list of availability statuses.

methods.name: getAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the permission is available.

methods.name: setAvailable
methods.description: Sets the availability status of the permission.

methods.name: getGroupIds
methods.description: Returns the set of group IDs associated with the permission.

methods.name: setGroupIds
methods.description: Sets the group IDs associated with the permission.
